questions.question: Whose city did Saul rescue from Nahash the Ammonite?
What happened after Saul's victory?
options: Saul fled away in fear from the gathered people
Saul fell badly wounded and very soon afterward died
The kingdom was renewed and Saul confirmed as king
Saul was rejected and quickly lost his royal throne
questions.answer: The kingdom was renewed and Saul confirmed as king

questions.question: The Spirit of God came on Saul and he rallied Israel to battle.
Saul defeated _____ the Ammonite, who had threatened Jabesh-gilead.
After the victory, the people renewed the _____ and confirmed Saul at Gilgal.
